protocol.name: andromeda_remote_input_v1
protocol.description: Private bridge for the RemoteDesktop portal backend. Creating a session grants no access. Each start requires compositor-owned user approval or a remembered grant; application labels are untrusted. Emulated input reaches the compositor only through the EIS connections a granted session hands out.

request.name: expire_scope
request.description: The portal forwards the disappearance of the requesting application's D-Bus peer. This only expires mode-one grants issued to this bridge client and application instance; durable grants are unaffected.

interface.name: andromeda_remote_input_session_v1
interface.description: Request identifiers correlate replies. Status values are zero for success, one for user cancellation, and two for failure. A session may start once. Capabilities: bit 0 keyboard, bit 1 pointer. Destroying the object, a revoked grant or a closed event ends every EIS connection of the session.

request.name: set_persistence
request.description: Mode zero requests a single session, one lasts for the application instance within this bridge client, and two lasts until revoked. The restore token is an opaque compositor grant. A missing or invalid grant requires approval. Valid only before start.

request.name: connect_eis
request.description: Valid only after a successful start. Answered by eis_fd or by result with status two.

event.name: grant

description.summary: approved permission to restore a later session

event.description: Sent before started for a successful remembered grant. The token is consumed by a successful restoration; use the returned token next time.

description.summary: the session ended: revoked, locked policy or compositor exit
